# Phase 1: Identify NOAA GHCN Parameters & Station Identifiers

## 1. Station Identifiers (`station_ids`)
GHCN station IDs are 11-character alphanumeric codes consisting of:
- **Characters 1–2**: 2-letter FIPS country code (e.g., `US` for United States, `CA` for Canada, `UK` for United Kingdom, `GM` for Germany, `FR` for France, `JA` for Japan, `ASN` / `AS` for Australia).
- **Character 3**: Network code (e.g., `W` for WBAN / US Weather Bureau Army Navy, `C` for COOP, `E` for ECA&D, `0` or numeric/letter for other national networks).
- **Characters 4–11**: Station-specific numeric or alphanumeric identifier (zero-padded if applicable).

## 2. Parameter Element Codes (`dataTypes`)
Parameter element codes are standard uppercase abbreviations for daily meteorological elements.

### Core GHCN-Daily Element Codes
| Plain Language Concept | Element Code (`dataTypes`) | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Maximum Temperature | `TMAX` | Daily maximum temperature |
| Minimum Temperature | `TMIN` | Daily minimum temperature |
| Average / Mean Temperature | `TAVG` | Daily average temperature |
| Temperature at Time of Observation | `TOBS` | Observation time temperature |
| Precipitation / Rainfall | `PRCP` | Daily total precipitation (water equivalent) |
| Snowfall | `SNOW` | Daily snowfall amount |
| Snow Depth | `SNWD` | Ground snow depth |
| Water Equivalent of Snow on Ground | `WESD` | Snow water equivalent |
| Water Equivalent of Snowfall | `WESF` | Snowfall water equivalent |
| Average Daily Wind Speed | `AWND` | Wind speed average |
| Peak Wind Gust Direction / Speed | `WSFG`, `WDFG` | Peak gust speed / direction |
| Direction / Speed of Fastest 2-min Wind | `WDF2`, `WSF2` | Fastest 2-minute wind |
| Direction / Speed of Fastest 5-sec Wind | `WDF5`, `WSF5` | Fastest 5-second wind |

### Element Selection Directives
- ✓ Request ONLY the element codes requested (e.g., `TMAX,TMIN,PRCP`).
- ✗ Do NOT pass lowercase or long names (`"temperature"`, `"precip"`, `"tmax"`).
- ✗ Do NOT guess unverified parameter names; stick strictly to standard NOAA GHCN element codes.
